convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'iDeMarkerSign' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all position open/close logic. Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator

other_exits: Signal-based close: if iDeMarkerSign UpValue appears on a historical bar (scanning forward from SignalBar+1), close SELL position. If DnValue appears, close BUY position. This is a separate lookback scan for reversal signals when both open and close permissions are enabled for same side.

params.MMMode_LOSSFREEMARGIN: 0.1 is fraction of (free margin minus loss)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=deposit fraction. MM input value interpretation changes based on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals read from custom indicator buffers at SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). UpValue (buffer 1) triggers BUY open and SELL close. DnValue (buffer 0) triggers SELL open and BUY close. When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are true and no close signal yet, EA scans forward through bars to find a prior reversal signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as gates to enable/disable each direction's entry and exit. SignalBar=0 allows intrabar recalculation on every tick.
python_conversion_notes: The iDeMarkerSign custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it wraps the standard DeMarker indicator with ATR-based signal generation and level crossover detection at UpLevel/DnLevel. Buffer 0 = down signals (DnValue), buffer 1 = up signals (UpValue). Non-zero non-EMPTY_VALUE values indicate a signal. TradeAlgorithms.mqh position sizing logic (5 MarginMode variants) must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - may need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers. The lookback scan for reversal signals (lines 134-160) adds complexity.
